name: Proclean Spray Mop for Floor Cleaning Wet & Dry Mop , 360 Degree Microfiber Dust Floor Mop with a Refillable Bottle Include 2 Microfiber Reusable Pads _SM-1770
description:
Product Details of 360° Rotating Spray Mop

Material: Lightweight and durable steel bar

Water Bottle Capacity: 300–500 ml

Dehydration Rate: 90%–100%

Mop Weight: 1–2 kg

Mop Handle Length: 120 cm

Mop Head Size: Approx. 38 cm

Packaging: Includes 2 mop heads

Spray Feature: Sprayer handle on top for fine mist of water or cleaning solution

Microfiber Pads: High-quality material for strong water absorption

Extra-Large Mop Head: Saves time and effort while mopping

Eco-Friendly: Made from environmentally friendly materials for safe cleaning

360° Rotation: Mop head rotates fully for easy cleaning in corners and tight spaces

Description:
This spray mop combines convenience, efficiency, and eco-friendliness. Its large microfiber head, 360° rotation, and built-in spray function make floor cleaning quick, easy, and thorough. Ideal for home or office use.
